name: notes-reveal
title: Notes Reveal
description: A personal note is typed character by character with a caret, the page scrolling up as each line lands, then it cuts to a paper card with a marker headline and a ticked checklist.
useWhen: A story told as one person's typed note, ending on a hand-lettered card with a checklist, as a vertical ad.
A calm personal tone with a clear payoff.
avoidWhen: The scene should be short: it runs about 25 seconds.
You need a different app mock-up: this is a notes page with a keyboard.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)
